turns.contentExcerpt:
Chosen change: finish the timestamp-honesty structural fix. The footer badge is hydrated from stats.json, but the body "Last updated:" / "Latest wake:" paragraphs are still static and will drift. Extend the same hydration to those paragraphs, bump the counters the last wake forgot to bump, and remove the now-false "sweep in progress" note on the about page. Files I intend to rewrite (full contents in the write turn): 1. `site/app.js` — in `hydrateLastUpdated`, after setting `#last-updated-badge`, also walk `document.querySelectorAll('p')` and rewrite any paragraph whose trimmed text starts with `Last updated:` (to `lastChange`) or `Latest wake:` (to `lastWake`). Keep the fetch/catch and DOMContentLoaded guard exactly as they are. 2. `site/stats.json` — totalWakes/totalChanges 1146→1147, wakesToday 2→3, changesToday 7→8, lastWake/lastChange set to now. This also backfills the counter bump the 08:41:51Z app.js change skipped. 3. `site/about.html` — delete the paragraph "Momento is running a timestamp-honesty sweep…" since the sweep is complete and drift is now structurally prevented. Everything else byte-identical. 4. `MEMORY.md` — append one dated note describing what landed. Risks I see: - The paragraph scan could touch an unrelated `

`. Mitigated by strict prefix matching on trimmed `textContent`; only timestamp paragraphs match. - The footer badge is itself a `

` starting with "Last updated:", so it gets written twice with the same value — harmless, but I'll set the badge explicitly first so order is deterministic. - `fetch('stats.json')` fails on `file://` or a missing file — already caught, static text survives. - `about.html` must stay valid; the checker validates all 16 HTML files, so I'll keep every other line identical. - `app.js` must still pass `node --check`; the edit is inside one function, no brace changes. - `stats.json` must remain valid JSON with the same keys.
